At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. stratagems.legend: The Terminators’ fervid need to annihilate ever more enemies manifests as a lurid empyric firestorm which wreathes their blows and the projectiles spat from their guns.

stratagems.legend: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.targetText: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.

stratagems.name: BEAUTIFUL DEATH
stratagems.legend: The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Emperor’s Children Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Emperor’s Children Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
stratagems.legend: Far from facing enemy champions in fair duels one‑on‑one, the Flawless Blades fall upon them like a pack of jackals competing viciously to claim the glory of the kill.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.targetText: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Scornfully dismissing the chaff that blocks their path, the Flawless Blades swat them aside and sweep regally on toward their true quarry.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).
stratagems.whenText: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.
stratagems.targetText: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

stratagems.name: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
stratagems.legend: Seeing their foes fleeing in terror before them only fires the chem‑laced blood of the Flawless Blades, urging them on toward their next challenge all the quicker.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.
stratagems.targetText: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Sublime Prescience
enhancements.legend: This leader’s tactical prowess ensures that their reinforcements arrive when required.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Emperor’s Children Transport that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Cacophonic Accompaniment
enhancements.legend: Like a parasite clinging to its host, this Lord Kakophonist’s mutated armour piggybacks on the teleport signals of Emperor’s Children Terminators, slingshotting him perilously through the Empyrean to explode onto the battlefield in a riot of discordant sonic fury.
enhancements.description:
LORD KAKOPHONIST model only.
• This model has Deep Strike.
• This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]

enhancements.name: Tears of the Phoenix
enhancements.legend: The addictive substance in these droplets is said to fracture consciousness – and sanity – to the point where the imbiber perceives every strike and parries their opponents’ attempts.
enhancements.description: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Weapon Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Euphoric Crown
enhancements.legend: This champion of Slaanesh wears a helm that absorbs and amplifies the frenzied carnival of carnage around them, driving the wearer into a frenzy of euphoric might.
enhancements.description: LORD EXULTANT model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Eager Patrons
enhancements.legend: The daemonic audience drawn by the deeds of these Flawless Blades is impatient for the spectacle to begin, and so bestows supernatural celerity upon those they consider the star performers.
enhancements.description: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.legend: This puissant champion of Slaanesh is ever eager to join the battle and prove their peerless skill to the Dark Prince.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.legend: Through Slaanesh’s favour, this warrior has defied death more than once and each time has been agonisingly resurrected to offer more souls to their patron.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. If that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.legend: Swirling clouds of perfumed empyric energy suffuse this leader s followers, granting them daemonic vigour.
enhancements.description: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.legend: This swordsman forever seeks opportunities to flaunt their dazzling and deadly bladework.
enhancements.description:
EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
• That use is -1 CP.
• That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.legend: The warlords of the Emperor’s Children thrive on the pain they cause. The more grievous the injuries they cause, the deadlier they become.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Beguiling Grotesquerie
enhancements.legend: Unable to tear their gaze from the hypnotically hideous features of the Flawless Blades, foes stare slack‑jawed in horrified fascination as their death stalks elegantly toward them.
enhancements.description: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Howling Plate
enhancements.legend: Mutant vox-emitters open like mouths all across this warrior’s grotesque armour, vomiting targeted sonic shock waves that enhance his allies’ already furious firepower.
enhancements.description: LORD EXULTANT model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Exalted Patron
enhancements.legend: This champion is a domineering martial lord, hungry for the adulation and audience of his warband’s most self-centred blademasters.
enhancements.description: Lord Exultant model only. Add 1" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

supportLeaderOverride.rawHtml: LEADER: FLAWLESS BLADES

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.legend: This leader is surrounded by an aura of dark majesty, radiating the glorious and infectious arrogance displayed by the greatest of Slaanesh’s chosen sons.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Repulsed by Weakness
enhancements.legend: Those chosen by Slaanesh seek only worthy foes. The weak and craven are slaughtered with sneering contempt.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings
enhancements.legend: This warrior has earned the favour of the Dark Prince.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Once per battle, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Frenzied Ferocity
enhancements.legend: Encumbered not at all despite the massive bulk of their armour, these Terminators’ mutant muscle and warp‑tainted reactions allow them to indulge in every aspect of attacking the foe to wild excess.
enhancements.description: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.legend: This leader and their bodyguard pride themselves being first into the fray.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Each time the bearer disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.legend: By injecting powerful combat stimms distilled from the perfumed ichor of Daemonettes, these warriors slash out with diabolically enhanced speed.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Musk
enhancements.legend: A sickly-sweet aroma emanates from this warrior, at once delightful and abhorrent. A perfumed assault on the senses intoxicates those in its vicinity.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.legend: Even amongst the prideful warriors of the Emperor’s Children, this warrior is a towering pillar of arrogance.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.legend: This warrior gifts their foes with Slaanesh’s own exquisite caress, offering up their agonies to please the Dark Prince.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Possessed Blade
enhancements.legend: The martial grace that this daemon weapon bestows upon its bearer comes at a price.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. At the start of the battle, select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer; add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon. In addition, each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, while resolving those attacks, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and that weapon has the [devastating wounds] and [hazardous] abilities.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.legend: The sheen of this blade reflects to the bearer their own alluring countenance. In their image, they see an example of perfection. In reality, the bearer has become a hideous wretch, every ounce of elegance leached away to increase the daemon blade’s killing power.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.legend: Possessed of uncanny situational awareness, this leader directs hit-and-fade attacks with great precision.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Once per turn, in your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly Emperor’s Children unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly Transport that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can embark within that Transport.

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.legend: Since their foundation, the Emperor's Children have sought to master every art of warfare, be it in personal acts of martial prowess or superior tactical displays.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Soulstain Made Manifest
enhancements.legend: The corruption of this warrior’s soul is so total that it bleeds outwards in a nimbus of nauseating eldritch horror that repulses his enemies.
enhancements.description: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.legend: Blessed by Slaanesh to further accentuate their perverse elegance, this leader possesses feline finesse.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

enhancements.name: Spiritsliver
enhancements.legend: This slender hellforged blade appears to weave in and out of being. Its daemonic bearer wields it in flickering arcs at supernatural speed, swift enough for its phantasmal edge to slice apart a victim’s soul before it is lost to the Warp.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Daemon Prince model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.legend: This warrior is well-versed in the fell rituals of the Dark Mechanicum.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly Emperor’s Children Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.legend: This warriors arrogance is matched by a listless ennui at the galaxy's everyday stimuli. Should a worthy opponent challenge them in combat, they transform into a faultless duellist with skill beyond compare.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children Infantry model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.legend: A daemonic patron steers this warrior’s fate. Every movement is a killing stroke or exquisitely timed parry.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. Once per turn, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer’s unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.legend: This warrior has obsessively perfected the arts of war for centuries if not millennia. Few champions, regardless of origin, are beyond their ability to kill.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Warp Walker
enhancements.legend: This champion of Slaanesh is so steeped in the warp as to be able to traverse its maddening depths at will.
enhancements.description: Emperor’s Children or Keeper of Secrets model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
